routing_warnings.description: The request to share changes in advance primarily concerns the clarification workflow rather than substantive conformance to approved shot direction.
Using detailed descriptions and online example frames as clarification aids primarily supports the pre-generation clarification Requirement.
The separate concern about achievable animation quality and further animation tests belongs to the animated-output Requirement rather than character artistic style fidelity.
The condition that new sets remain stylistically consistent across shots belongs to background style continuity rather than image quality.
The client reports that the revised sets became too similar, which concerns visual distinction between sets.
In the immediately preceding exchange, the client's improvement assessment follows revisions addressing excessive similarity between sets.
The requested removal of bridges concerns Q's background composition rather than general background image quality.
The client's willingness to change shot angles is specifically tied to improving set-image quality rather than redefining the paired framing sequence.
This message concerns using script-specified angles when the storyboard differs, not the established three-pair Q and Deadwax progression.
This message establishes a clarification process for shots that deviate from the storyboard rather than changing the target framing sequence.
The Q-set discussion concerns scaling and cropping rather than visual distinction between story sets.
The request to remove the two lower bridges while retaining the upper bridge belongs to the independent Q background bridge-composition Requirement.
The request to restore character shadows belongs to the independent character-shadows Requirement.
The comparison showing that earlier renders had character shadows while the current renders do not is failure evidence for the character-shadows Requirement.
